description: This file defines the PdfResourceMap class, which is a specialized dictionary used in a PDF processing library to map resource names to objects within the PDF structure. It includes constructors for different initialization scenarios and a method to collect resource names from the PDF element hierarchy.

classes.name: PdfResourceMap
classes.description: A base class for mapping resource names to PDF objects within a PDF document, extending PdfDictionary.

methods.name: PdfResourceMap
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the map with a PdfDocument.

methods.name: PdfResourceMap
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the map from an existing PdfDictionary.

methods.name: CollectResourceNames
methods.description: Adds all resource name keys from the current element set to the provided dictionary, avoiding duplicates.
